Public Financial Management System (PFMS) Portal

either by indicating their Aadhaar Number, Bank Account number or NSP Application ID.

NOTE 1:

The National Scholarships Portal will provide the timelines for opening & closing of the portal.

NOTE 2:

Online applications will be verified at two levels i.e. by the Institute, where the student is studying and thereafter by the concerned State Higher Education Department or any other Agency/ Official nominated by the State as State Nodal Agency (both for fresh and renewal applicants).

NOTE 3:

Students will not be permanently debarred for scholarships due to delay in renewal or verification. However, students will have to submit renewal applications within a cut-off date. Renewal for that year will not be allowed if an applicant misses this deadline.

Required documents

Aadhaar

Copy of SSC/10th certificate & mark sheet,

Copy of HSC/12th certificate (In case of Degree level) & mark sheet.

Copy of ITI certificate (In case of Lateral Entry for Diploma level) & mark sheet.

Copy of Diploma certificate (In case of Lateral Entry for Degree level) & mark sheet.

Category Certificate, if applicable.

Study/ Bonafide Certificate (Appendix-I).

Annual Family Income Certificate (Appendix-II).

Promotion Certificate in case of renewal (Appendix-III).

Frequently asked questions

Question: I Am Studying In 3rd Year Of Diploma/ Degree Course. Will I Get Saksham Scholarship?

Answer: No, you are not eligible.

Question: I Am Degree/Diploma Student And Recipient Of One Of The Merit Scholarships Of Centre / State Government. Am I Eligible To Apply For SAKSHAM Scholarship?

Answer: No, Students who are already in receipt of any of the scholarships (Central Govt. / State Govt. / AICTE Sponsored), are not eligible to apply for SAKSHAM Scholarship.

Question: I Am First Year B.E Student Along With Beneficiary Of PMSSS Scheme Studying In One Of The Leading Engineering College Having Eligibility For SAKSHAM Scholarship. Am I Eligible To Apply For SAKSHAM Scholarship?

Answer: No, you are not eligible, since you are already in receipt of one of the Scholarships of Government of India.

Question: What Is The Mode Of Disbursement Of Scholarship?

Answer: Scholarship will be disbursed only through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in the bank account of the student by AICTE. Student must have General Saving Account in his / her name (FRILL/Minor/Joint account will not be accepted).

Question: Is AADHAAR Card A Mandatory Document For SAKSHAM Scholarship?

Answer: Yes, Aadhaar card and Aadhaar seeded bank account in the name of candidate is mandatory for submitting online application under SAKSHAM scheme.

Question: Is There Any E-Mail (Or) Helpline No. For SAKSHAM Scholarship Queries?

Answer: Yes, you can avail helpline services on saksham@aicte-india.org & 011-29581118 for any query

Question: Whom To Contact In Case Of Any Difficulties In Accessing The Portal For Submitting Online Application?

Answer: You can avail Helpdesk Service on helpdesk@nsp.gov.in for any query.

Question: What Are The Reasons Of Direct Rejection Of Application Under SAKSHAM Scheme?

Answer: Followings may be the reasons: • Student is admitted in Non-Technical courses or Course is not approved by AICTE in the current academic year. • University / Institute is not approved by the AICTE in the current academic year. • Incomplete/Wrong information filled in submitted application. Page 3 of 6 • Student admitted in duel degree courses. • Student is availing scholarship from any other sources. • Student admitted in Post-graduate courses. • Disability Certificate is not enclosed / Not issued by Competent Authority.

Question: What Are The Reasons Of Rejection Of Annual Family Income Certificate?

Answer: Followings may be the reasons: • Annual family income certificate of current year is not submitted. • Annual family income certificate is not in the name of applicant or any his/her family member. • Submitted Annual family income certificate issued by other than competent authority (Tehshildar, Magistrate, Revenue officer/Block Development officer etc.). • Annual family income certificate submitted without signature/stamp of the competent authority.

Question: What Are The Reasons Of Rejection Of Promotion Certificate?

Answer: Followings may be the reasons • Incomplete or blank promotion certificate submitted. • Promotion certificate submitted without college’s stamp or signature of the Principal / Director.

Question: What Are The Reasons Of Rejection Of HSC/SSC Certificate?

Answer: Followings may be the reasons: • Copy of HSC/SSC certificate is blurred. • Copy of HSC/SSC certificate is not accessible. • Copy of HSC/SSC is not in the name of applicant. • Irrelevant Document attached in place of HSC/SSC.

Overview

Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young specially-abled student the opportunity to study further.

Detailed description

Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young student, who is otherwise specially abled, the opportunity to study further and prepare for a successful future through technical education/ knowledge. ₹50,000/- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 3 years for the first year admitted students and maximum 2 years for the second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipment, software, etc. The candidate should be admitted to the First year of the Diploma level course OR the Second year of the Diploma level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE-approved institutions of the respective year. Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year.

Benefits

₹50,000/- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 3 years for the first year admitted students and maximum 2 years for the second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipment, software, etc.

After selection, the awardee will be paid a scholarship through DBT mode on annual basis.

The scholarship will be renewed for the next year of study on receipt of renewal through National Scholarship Portal by submitting a passing certificate/ mark sheet along with a letter from the Head of the Institution on the online portal

Exclusions

Students failing to get promoted to the next class/ level would forfeit the scholarship.

The gap period between the year of passing the qualifying examination and the session of admission in the diploma course should not be more than two years.

If a candidate failed/drops out in a subsequent year, she/ he will not be eligible for further scholarship.

The grant of scholarship is subject to the condition that the student does not receive any financial assistance in the shape of scholarship/any emoluments, salary, stipend, etc. from any other source during her/ his course of study in the Institute. In case of receipt of any financial assistance from any other sources, the scholarship shall be discontinued and the entire amount of the scholarship will have to be refunded to AICTE by D/Draft drawn in favor of “Member Secretary, AICTE” payable at New Delhi.

Eligibility

The candidate should be admitted to the first year of the diploma-level course or the second year of the diploma-level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE-approved institutions of the respective year.

Specially-abled students have a disability of not less than 40%.

Family income from all sources should not be more than ₹ 8,00,000/- per annum during the current financial year. A valid income certificate issued by the state/UT government needs to be enclosed.

Online

New Registration

Step 1:

Visit the

page of the National Scholarships Portal.

Step 2:

Guidelines for Registration will appear. Scroll to the bottom. Read the undertaking carefully and Accept the Terms. Click “Next”.

Step 3:

In the next window, enter your mobile number and OTP. Then click “Verify”.

After successful verification, continue with e-KYC process (as applicable).

AadhaarFaceRD

services in the android device.

NSP OTR

Scheme: Swachh Bharat Mission – Urban 2.0

Ministry: Ministry Of Housing & Urban Affairs

Level: Central

Scheme type: Centrally Sponsored Scheme

Target beneficiaries: Individual, Family

Overview

A sanitation scheme for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) for urban households.

Detailed description

A sanitation scheme for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) for urban households. The Mission has the following components:

Household toilets, including conversion of insanitary latrines into pour-flush latrines.

Community toilets

Public toilets

Solid waste management

IEC & Public Awareness

Capacity building and Administrative & Office Expenses (A&OE)

Benefits

A Financial support of minimum

Rs - 6667 (in Andhra Pradesh ,Bihar, Chhattisgarh ,Goa, Gujarat, Haryana, Jharkhand, Karnataka ,Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra ,Odisha, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal),

Rs - 12,000 (in Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura, Assam)

Rs - 5333 (in Union Territories) is provided for Toilet Construction

Eligibility

Any household that does not have access to an individual household toilet (

80% of urban households engaging in open defecation

) or has an insanitary toilet.

Application process

Online

Applicant creates an Applicant Login ID by registering on IHHL using Name , Mobile Number , Email , Address , ID Type, ID Number.

After successful login the applicant enters the following details

In Geographical Particulars (State, District, ULB Name, Ward No.)

Toilet Owner’s Particulars (Name*, Gender*, Father/ Husband’s Name*, Mobile No*, Residential Address*, Status of Existing Toilet, Aadhar Linked Transfer of Incentive, Aadhar Number, Bank Account Detail*, Photograph*)

After successful submission of Application, An IHHL Application Acknowledgement slip is generated with Application ID and Bank Account Detail

Required documents

Indicative Documents

Aadhar Linked Transfer of Incentive

Aadhar Number

Bank Account Detail - Passbook

Photograph

Definitions

Discharging directly to drains or other water-body

All households with single-pit latrines

Insanitary toilet

Scheme guideline

Frequently asked questions

Question: How will I receive my financial support under the Scheme?

Answer: All financial incentives will be deposited directly (by electronic clearing service) into the bank accounts of the beneficiary households (including accounts opened under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana). No cash/cheque disbursals shall take place.

Question: Will I receive the entire amount in one go if I am eligible for the scheme?

Answer: No, 50% of the incentive will be released on approval by the ULB. Remaining 50% of Central Government incentive as 2nd instalment should be released to the identified beneficiary household upon verification of physical progress of construction of the household toilet.

Question: Where can I upload the picture of the toilet to claim remaining amount?

Answer: You can upload the picture at http://swachhbharaturban.gov.in/ihhl/writereaddata/UserManual_ToiletPhotoUpload_CSC_ULB_Applicant.pdf

Scheme: Short Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research

Ministry: Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

Implementing agency: Department Of Health Research, Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare, Government Of India

Level: Central

Scheme type: Central Sector Scheme

Target beneficiaries: Individual

Overview

The scheme aims to provide short-term advanced training and financial support to medical and health research personnel to enhance their skills and promote research in priority health areas.

Detailed description

The scheme "ICMR-Junior Research Fellowship" by the Department of Health Research (DHR), Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, aims to enhance the availability of trained health research personnel through providing short-term training fellowships and financial assistance to medical faculty and researchers. It supports training in both Indian and foreign institutions for a duration of 1-3 months. The scheme focuses on priority areas such as clinical trials, genomics, toxicology, and biotechnology. It encourages multidisciplinary collaboration and the development of research projects addressing national and local health challenges. The fellowship also aims to build a skilled workforce in advanced medical and health research domains.

Benefits

For Training In Indian Institutes (1-3 Months):

Stipend:

₹40,000/- per month (if training is at a different station); ₹20,000/- per month (if training is at the same station).

Travel Support:

Travelling expenses are provided as per Travelling Allowance rules of the parent organization.

Contingency Grant: One-time grant up to ₹20,000/- for local travel, meetings, and related expenses.

For Training In Foreign Institutes (1-3 Months):

US $3000/- per month or equivalent in other foreign currency.

Air Travel:

Economy class airfare by Air India via the shortest route from parent institute to host institute.

Contingency Grant:

One-time grant up to ₹30,000/- for visa, insurance, local expenses, meetings; additional ₹20,000/- for attending review meetings.

Conference Grant:

US $600/- for attending conferences or institutes of interest with approval.

Eligibility

Only Indian citizens working in Indian institutes are eligible.

Scheme: Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana

Ministry: Ministry Of Health & Family Welfare

Department: Department of Health and Family Welfare

Level: Central

Scheme type: Central Sector Scheme

Target beneficiaries: Individual

Overview

The scheme aims to provide assured, dignified, and completely free healthcare services to all pregnant women, mothers, and newborns at public health facilities.

Detailed description

Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana (SUMAN) is a maternity benefit initiative launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The scheme aims to provide affordable, high-quality healthcare solutions to pregnant women and newborns. Under this scheme, ensuring assured, dignified, respectful, and quality healthcare services at zero cost for all pregnant women, mothers, and newborns visiting public health facilities.

Objectives of the SUMAN scheme:

To achieve zero preventable maternal and newborn deaths.

To ensure assured, free, and quality healthcare services for every pregnant woman and newborn.

To provide dignified and respectful care, maintaining privacy and confidentiality.

To enforce zero tolerance for denial of services at public health facilities.

To ensure comprehensive maternal and newborn care, including antenatal, delivery, and postnatal services.

Benefits

Under SUMAN, beneficiaries are entitled to the following free and cashless services at designated public health facilities:

Maternal Health Services

Minimum 4 Antenatal Care (ANC) check-ups, including one in the first trimester

At least one check-up under Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)

Free and cashless normal delivery and Caesarean section (C-section)

Management of pregnancy-related complications

Newborn & Infant Care

Free care for sick newborns and infants

Zero-dose vaccinations (as per the government schedule)

6 Home-Based Newborn Care (HBNC) visits

Early initiation and support for breastfeeding

Transport & Logistics

Free transport from home to the health facility

Inter-facility referral transport

Drop-back facility after discharge

Other Entitlements

Free drugs, diagnostics, and blood services

Postnatal care and counseling, including family planning

Respectful maternity care, ensuring dignity, privacy, and choice

Zero out-of-pocket expenditure for all entitled services

Eligibility

The applicant must be a pregnant woman.

The applicant must be a mother (post-delivery) seeking services at a public health facility.

Newborns aged 0 to 6 months old will be able to avail the benefits of this scheme.

After delivery, lactating mothers up to 6 months from delivery are also eligible for this scheme.

Application process

Offline

Individuals have to visit civil hospitals in their respective areas to register themselves for the PM SUMAN Yojana. Ideally, they have to fulfill the eligibility criteria and submit the mentioned documents to register for the scheme.

The civil hospitals of all the districts abide by the rules mandated by the Health Ministry. However, if there are some discrepancies, individuals can log in to the SUMAN website and file a complaint. Individuals have to submit certain documents to prove their identity.

Grievance Redressal

Access to grievance registration through:

104 toll-free helpline

SUMAN

web portal

Facility-level helpdesks

Time-bound resolution (within 21 days)

Required documents

Identity Proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, driving license, voter ID card, etc.)

Women's Pregnancy Details from a Concerned Hospital

Address Proof

Any Other Documents as Required

Frequently asked questions

Question: Who are the beneficiaries under SUMAN?

Answer: All pregnant women, mothers, and newborns visiting public health facilities are eligible for services under SUMAN.

Question: What services are provided free of cost under SUMAN?

Answer: Services include: Antenatal care (ANC) checkups Institutional delivery (including C-section) Postnatal care (PNC) Free drugs, diagnostics, and blood Free transport (home to hospital and drop-back) Newborn care and immunization

Question: What is meant by “zero tolerance for denial of services”?

Answer: It means no eligible beneficiary can be denied healthcare services at public health facilities under any circumstances.

Question: What are SUMAN compliant facilities?

Answer: These are public health facilities that meet quality standards (NQAS/IPHS) and provide assured maternal and newborn services as per SUMAN guidelines.

Question: What are the different service packages under SUMAN?

Answer: There are three levels: Basic Package – Primary level care BEmONC – Basic Emergency Obstetric & Newborn Care CEmONC – Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric & Newborn Care

Question: What is the SUMAN Service Guarantee Charter?

Answer: It is a commitment ensuring free, respectful, and quality healthcare services for every mother and newborn at SUMAN facilities.

Question: How can beneficiaries register grievances under SUMAN?

Answer: Grievances can be registered through: 104 toll-free helpline SUMAN web portal Help desks at facilities

Question: What role do SUMAN volunteers play?

Answer: Volunteers act as a bridge between the community and health system, helping beneficiaries access services, spreading awareness, and supporting emergency referrals.

Question: What is the role of community institutions under SUMAN?

Answer: Institutions like PRIs, SHGs, NGOs, and VHSNCs help in awareness, monitoring services, and ensuring accountability.

Question: What is the incentive for reporting maternal deaths?

Answer: An incentive of ₹1000 is provided to the first person who reports a maternal death through the 104 helpline (after verification).
